source_claims.claim: Configuration explicitly restricted to single j shell; BCS particle/hole doubled space. Unique spherical epsilon_j set to zero, not a general removal of multiorbital level spacings.
Core rotational Hamiltonian identical in particle/hole space, Eq2.13; fixed irrotational shape dependence with common J0, Eq2.14.
Gamma reflection/axis operation Gamma includes beta unchanged, gamma->60-gamma, lambda->-lambda, Delta->-Delta, axes(1,2,3)->(3,1,2). Combined sigma_y Gamma gives full model unitary equivalence.

Actual calculation separately neglects qp-qh rotational mixing h*eta in Eq2.30; exact symmetry and approximation validity are distinct. Source discusses eta=0 far outside shell and weak-deformation rationale when lambda penetrates shell.

Under source-defined combined mapping, Q is odd and M even. Corresponding signed E2 RME changes sign and M1 does not; source Eq2.51 paragraph says Qsp and delta reverse sign. Applies only to source operators and matched states/common phase/radiation conventions.
Source parameters k,J0,Delta and b=beta*A^(2/3) scaling are phenomenological single-j model prescriptions, not WK22 actual input.

task_contract.exact_multiorbital_sufficient_condition: There must exist same-dimensional closed-space U and explicit E0 such that h_prime-E0 I=-U(h-E0 I)U^dagger, with pair/core/axis/truncation/approximation covariance and lambda_prime-E0=-(lambda-E0). Single-j quadrupole model is sufficient example, not mathematical necessity for every model.
task_contract.zero_reference: If program uses E, Lambda and shell center E0, require E_prime=2E0-E, Lambda_prime=2E0-Lambda. Literal -Lambda applies only at common E0=0.
task_contract.BCS_mapped_equality: For centered epsilon_prime=-epsilon, lambda_prime=-lambda, |Delta_prime|=|Delta|, e_qp equal and u_prime^2=v^2.
task_contract.delta_relative: Within original operators/matched state map/common phases and radiation conventions, and M1 nonzero, delta_prime=-delta while corresponding B unchanged; not a mere state rephase and not an actual Ce prediction.
